jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Årsoppgjør i Duett er ikke en løsning på siden, men en integrert del av regnskapsprogrammet. Dokumentasjonen samles inn gjennom hele året, slik at det meste av jobben allerede er gjort når året er omme. Forhåndsutfylte tall hentes fra Altinn, anleggsregisteret beregner og bokfører avskrivninger automatisk, og de fleste foretak kan sende komplett skattemelding med næringsspesifikasjon direkte fra Duett. Dette er et forretningskritisk domene med harde frister og lite rom for feil.
Du blir en del av Team Annual Report og jobber tett med Payroll- og Payment-teamene. Du liker å forstå fagdomenet like godt som koden, og du er komfortabel med å oversette regelverk og myndighetskrav til robuste løsninger. I det daglige bruker du Claude, Cursor eller Copilot – ikke fordi det er trendy, men fordi det gjør deg bedre.

Hvorfor denne rollen er attraktiv
Du jobber med et domene som har svært stor betydning for oss – der feil kan få reelle konsekvenser for kundene våre.
Hos oss er AI en arbeidsmåte. Vi bruker Claude i det daglige og utvikler oss kontinuerlig.
Moderne techstack med .NET Core, Angular og Azure – og et fagmiljø både i Norge og Polen.
Duett er i sterk vekst. Vi bygger løsninger for fremtiden.

Dette blir hverdagen din
Videreutvikling av årsoppgjørsløsningen.
Integrasjoner mot Skatteetaten og Altinn.
Implementering av årlige regelendringer og nye versjoner av myndighetenes formater og API-er.
Ytelse og stabilitet – spesielt når sesongtoppen kommer.
Høy kodekvalitet, beste praksis og aktiv bruk av Claude.

Hva har du med deg?
Must-haves

Fullstack-erfaring i .NET og moderne frontend-rammeverk (f.eks. Angular).
Stor forståelse for integrasjoner og komplekse systemer, gjerne mot offentlige API-er.
Selvstendig og proaktiv.
Flytende norsk og engelsk, skriftlig og muntlig.
Erfaring med AI-agenter og Claude Code, Cursor eller GitHub Copilot.

Nice-to-haves

Forståelse av regnskap og årsoppgjør i Norge – hvordan regnskapet går fra hovedbok til årsregnskap og skattemelding, og forskjellen på regnskapsmessig og skattemessig behandling. Dette teller mye.
Erfaring fra regnskapsbyrå, revisjon eller utvikling av ERP-/regnskapssystemer.
Kjennskap til Altinn 3, Maskinporten og Skatteetatens API-er.
Kjennskap til regnskapsloven, skatteloven og god regnskapsskikk.
Erfaring med XML-/XSD-baserte formater, XBRL eller SAF-T.
Erfaring med beregningstunge domener eller regelmotorer.

Hvorfor Duett?
Hos Duett AS blir du en del av et kompetent og inkluderende fagmiljø med engasjerte og trivelige kolleger. Vi samarbeider på tvers av forretningsområder og lokasjoner, og legger vekt på et arbeidsmiljø preget av stor takhøyde, god dialog og en uformell tone. Vi tilbyr konkurransedyktige betingelser, gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger, samt fleksible løsninger med mulighet for hjemmekontor.
Vi er opptatt av likestilling, inkludering og mangfold, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Developer
jobs.description:
.NET Developer

Are you passionate about building technology that powers seamless digital experiences at scale?

An innovative Norwegian technology-driven business is looking for a .NET Developer to join its growing development team. The company is a market leader within its industry, delivering proprietary digital platforms, data-driven services, and customer-facing solutions used by businesses across Norway and the wider Nordic region. The organisation has made significant investments in technology and product development, with software playing a central role in its future growth strategy.
This is an opportunity to work on business-critical systems, modernise platforms, and contribute to products used by thousands of users every day.

The Role

As a Senior .NET Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining modern applications and services that support both customer and internal business operations.
You will collaborate closely with developers, product specialists, architects, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality software solutions while influencing technical direction and best practices across the team.

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain scalable applications using .NET and C#
Design and build APIs, integrations, and backend services
Contribute to architecture decisions and technical roadmaps
Drive code quality through reviews, testing, and mentoring
Work closely with product teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions
Improve system performance, reliability, and security
Support the continued evolution of cloud-based and data-driven solutions

Desired Experience

Strong commercial experience with C# and .NET

Experience building distributed systems, APIs, and integrations
Knowledge of Azure and cloud-native development practices
Experience working with SQL databases
Familiarity with modern frontend technologies is advantageous
Strong understanding of software architecture and engineering best practices
Experience working within agile development environments

What They're Looking For

A collaborative and proactive mindset
Passion for technology and continuous improvement
Strong communication skills
Ability to balance technical excellence with business value
Someone who enjoys taking ownership and influencing technical decisions

Why Join?

Opportunity to work for a well-established business undergoing continued technology investment and growth
Modern technology environment with a strong focus on in-house product development
Collaborative and supportive engineering culture
Significant autonomy and influence over technical solutions
Competitive salary and benefits package
Flexible and hybrid working environment

Location:
Oslo

Permanent

Full Norwegian proficiency required

If you're an experienced .NET developer looking to work on impactful products in a technology-led organisation, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Software Engineer til Advertisement & Partner Management i TV 2 Teknologi
jobs.location: København SV, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Vil du bygge løsninger, som har direkte betydning for TV 2s forretning?
I Advertisement & Partner Management udvikler vi de systemer, der gør det muligt at planlægge, booke og håndtere reklamer på TV 2s platforme. Det er et område med stor betydning for forretningen, høj kompleksitet og gode muligheder for at skabe mærkbare resultater.
Vi søger en software engineer med nogle års erfaring, som kan bygge gode løsninger og trives i et team, hvor faglighed, samarbejde og godt arbejdsmiljø går hånd i hånd.
Du bliver en del af et område i udvikling. Vi moderniserer vores løsninger, bygger nye cloud-baserede services og udforsker, hvordan AI og agentiske workflows kan blive en naturlig del af softwareudviklingen. Derfor leder vi efter en kollega, der er nysgerrig på teknologi og har lyst til at bidrage til fællesskabet.
Rollen
Som Software Engineer arbejder du tæt sammen med udviklere, product management, designere og forretningen.
Du får ansvar og medbestemmelse fra dag ét og bliver en del af et miljø, hvor vi hjælper hinanden med at komme i mål. Vi forventer ikke, at du har svar på alt, men vi håber, at du er nysgerrig, stiller spørgsmål og bidrager til teamets udvikling.
Vi arbejder blandt andet med .NET/C#, API'er og cloud-løsninger på AWS og er i gang med at modernisere vores systemlandskab mod en mere serviceorienteret arkitektur.
Dine primære opgaver bliver at:
udvikle og videreudvikle backend-services og API'er.
arbejde med integrationer, databaser og forretningskritiske dataflows.
bidrage til tekniske beslutninger og løbende forbedringer.
tage ansvar for opgaver fra analyse og udvikling til test, release og drift.
samarbejde tæt med udviklere, product management og forretningen.
anvende AI-værktøjer og moderne udviklingsmetoder i hverdagen.

Teamet
Du bliver en del af et tværfagligt team med software engineers, designere, product management og tæt kontakt til forretningen.
Vi har stor tillid til hinanden og lægger vægt på, at det skal være både fagligt spændende og rart at gå på arbejde. Det er helt almindeligt at bede om hjælp, sparre om løsninger og dele idéer undervejs.
Vi tager vores arbejde seriøst, men ikke os selv alt for højtideligt. Derfor håber vi også, at du bidrager positivt til fællesskabet og har lyst til at dele viden, skabe energi og hjælpe med at gøre teamet til et sted, hvor folk ser frem til at møde ind.
Uanset om du motiveres af kode, teknologi, domæneforståelse eller samarbejde med mennesker, får du mulighed for at udvikle dig og bidrage til løsningerne.
Det primære arbejdssted er Teglholmen i København.
Din profil
Du har nogle års erfaring som software engineer og er klar til at tage ansvar for både løsninger og samarbejde.
Du behøver ikke at have prøvet det hele før. Det vigtigste er, at du er dygtig til dit håndværk, har lyst til at lære nyt og motiveres af at skabe værdi sammen med andre.
Vi forestiller os, at du:
har erfaring med backend-udvikling i .NET/C#.
har arbejdet med API'er, integrationer og databaser.
har erfaring med moderne softwareudvikling og god kodekvalitet.
har arbejdet med cloud-platforme/AWS.
arbejder struktureret med Git, test og samarbejde omkring kode.
er nysgerrig på nye teknologier og AI-understøttet softwareudvikling.

Vi forestiller os, at du også har erfaring med:
JavaScript eller TypeScript.
React eller andre moderne frontend-frameworks.
messaging og eventbaserede arkitekturer.
GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes og Terraform.
Power Platform, Dynamics og Umbraco.

Hvem håber vi, du er?
Du er typen, der:
får tingene til at ske uden at skulle have alting perfekt på forhånd.
er nysgerrig og har lyst til hele tiden at lære nyt.
hjælper andre og selv beder om hjælp, når det giver mening.
bidrager til et godt samarbejde omkring dig.
kan lide at samarbejde med mennesker, der tænker anderledes end dig selv.
synes, at det er sjovere at vinde som hold end alene.

Vi søger en kollega, som har lyst til at være en del af et fagligt dygtigt team, bidrage med sine kompetencer og gøre hverdagen bedre for de mennesker, man arbejder sammen med.
TV 2 som teknologiarbejdsplads
I TV 2s teknologiorganisation arbejder over 320 specialister hver dag med at udvikle hele den teknologiske værdikæde – fra avanceret medieteknologi og liveproduktion til digitale produkter som apps, streamingtjenester, dataløsninger og brugeroplevelser. Det er her, vi omsætter målet om personlig public service til konkrete løsninger, som møder danskernes behov på tværs af platforme.
Vi arbejder i tværfaglige teams – med bl.a. Software Engineers, UX‑designere, Enterprise Architects, konfigurationsspecialister og Data Scientists – og vi har fokus på kvalitet, tilgængelighed, performance og sikkerhed i alt, hvad vi bygger og driver. Du får kolleger i både Odense på Kvægtorvet og i København på Teglholmen samt en kultur, hvor læring, videndeling og ansvar går hånd i hånd med dynamikken i Danmarks største mediehus.
Søg stillingen
Du sender dit CV og en kort motivation via formularen nedenfor. Ansøgningsfrist er d.12.oktober, hvorefter vi inviterer til samtaler.
Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

jobs.description:
Kickstart your developer career while building solutions that make a real difference for Danish citizens.

Are you passionate about providing solutions that serves a higher purpose and adds value to society? Is .NET code, Visual Studio, AI, and working in an international environment sweet music to your ears?

Then you are exactly who we are searching for!

EG Digital Welfare is seeking a student assistant who is passionate and self-driven to join our Self-Service team, which is based in Aalborg. The team is responsible for developing applications that strengthens self-service abilities within the public sector in Denmark where our product portfolio includes both new and older technologies. So, if you're seeking a study-relevant job and you are studying to become a developer, you should continue reading!

As part of the department

EG Digital Welfare is part of EG (a large international Nordic software company with over 3000 employees) and delivers expertly based digital solutions to the private and public market. We are a professional software company with deeply committed colleagues who have a shared vision of delivering value-creating digital solutions of the highest quality. You will be part of our Product Development department, where you will challenge and be challenged by the tasks every day.

You'll have the opportunity to work with applications that facilitate the processing of cases within the Danish public sector, benefiting Danish citizens - you have probably used one of our solutions yourself. Our applications have many different types of users and handle sensitive personal information of Danish citizens.

This is a temporary, part-time position of approximately 15 hours per week, based in Aalborg.

Your tasks: Development, implementation, and collaboration

Contribute actively to task development and implementation within the Self-Service team.
Work with applications supporting case processing within the Danish public sector.
Collaborate with team members across the world, communicating daily in English.
Help ensure security and GDPR compliance across our solutions.
Bring innovative ideas to the team and contribute to ongoing improvements.

You are the ideal candidate if you

Are fluent in Danish and have verbal and written communication skills in English.
Are familiar with .NET MVC and C#.
Have interest in working with HTML, JavaScript and JQuery.
Have knowledge about Razor pages or a willingness to learn.
Have a positive mindset and appreciate being a part of a good team.
Are not afraid to contribute with your innovative ideas.
Can commit to working approx. 15 hours per week.
Are Interested in working with AI in a professional environment.

What's in it for you?

We offer good personal development opportunities, including free access to LinkedIn Learning.
High spirits, bad jokes, and a casual tone.
A team that makes its own decisions.
Committed and skilled colleagues who take responsibility, show care, and help each other.
We offer a flexible working environment to meet the demands of your studies.
Flexibility to shift between working from the office and working from home.

Our Values

Lead the Industry — We bring deep industry expertise and help our customers lead their industry.
Make it Happen — We take ownership, move fast and deliver real impact.
Stronger Together — We collaborate across borders with high standards, trust, openness and no politics.

We look forward to hearing from you!

To learn more about the position before applying, please reach out to our Team Manager, Urszula Koscijanczuk via email at xxguv@eg.dk. You can submit your CV and a motivated application through the link on this page, preferably as soon as possible, as we review CVs and applications on an ongoing basis. All inquiries are treated confidentially.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Teradyne, Singapore)
jobs.description:
About Teradyne

Teradyne is a leading supplier of Automatic Test Equipment (ATE) used to test complex electronics in the consumer electronics, automotive, computing, telecommunications, aerospace, and defense industries. Teradyne helps bring high-quality innovations in smart devices, life-saving medical equipment, and data storage systems to market faster through its advanced test solutions for semiconductors and electronic systems.

In 2023, Teradyne generated $2.7 billion in revenue and employed approximately 6,500 people worldwide.

The Semiconductor Test Division is the world's largest supplier of semiconductor test equipment for logic, RF, analog, power, mixed-signal, and memory technologies. The Nextest division is responsible for the Magnum family of memory test products.

For more information, visit www.teradyne.com .

Our Purpose

At Teradyne, experience meets innovation as we drive excellence in every connection. We are fueled by creativity, diversity of thought, and the strength of our workforce. Our employees are driven to innovate and learn something new every day.

We cultivate an inclusive culture that respects each employee’s strengths, perspectives, and experiences. We believe our differences make us a stronger team—one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers stronger business results.

Organization & Role

Nextest is looking for software engineers to join an exciting, dynamic, hardworking, engaging, and collaborative team. As an individual contributor, you will be involved in all aspects of software engineering and complex problem-solving, working with cross-functional teams to define, implement, and test new features and functionality.

Nextest engineering teams bring deep technical expertise across both software and hardware. Our engineers thrive in a dynamic, customer-driven, global work environment where they succeed through innovation and collaboration. Internally, we work closely with Systems Engineering, Hardware Engineering, and QA. Externally, we partner with Field Support and customers to deliver impactful solutions.

Opportunity Overview

In this role, you will:

Understand customer requirements and find innovative ways to incorporate them into our existing software architecture.
Learn from our most senior engineers while bringing your own experience and perspective to help drive the next generation of Teradyne solutions.
Collaborate with our senior team to design and develop programs and libraries for new products.
Assist with sustaining and extending programs and libraries for existing products.
Engage with our Field Applications team to find innovative ways to improve customer success and solve customer problems.
Work with the Software QA group to develop effective test strategies, identify improvement areas, and resolve issues in internal and customer-facing software releases.

All About You

We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you’re ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
8+ years of professional software development experience.
Expert-level proficiency in C++ and/or C# with strong object-oriented design and programming skills.
Strong experience developing software that interfaces directly with hardware, including FPGA-, ASIC-, or instrument-based systems.
Solid hands-on experience with .NET application development.
Strong understanding of software quality practices, including unit testing, automated testing, and continuous integration methodologies.
Proficiency in Windows application development and debugging using Microsoft Visual Studio.
Strong knowledge of the C++ Standard Template Library (STL) and modern C++ development practices.
Experience with source code management and collaborative development tools, including Git/GitLab, code review processes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience using Jira or similar Agile project management tools for requirement tracking, sprint planning, and issue management.
Demonstrated experience leading technical initiatives or mentoring engineering teams.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to cross-functional teams.
Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently while contributing effectively within a team environment.
Good command of written and spoken English.

Preferred Qualifications

Extensive experience collaborating with hardware engineering teams, including interpreting schematics, hardware specifications, and design documentation.
Experience developing Windows device drivers, particularly using the Kernel-Mode Driver Framework (KMDF).
Strong understanding of Windows operating system internals and low-level system programming.
Proven track record of successfully delivering commercial products to customers.
Experience with instrument control, measurement systems, or test equipment software development.
Experience in Automated Test Equipment (ATE) systems, preferably in semiconductor memory testing.
Experience developing Windows-based GUI applications using WPF, MFC, or similar frameworks.

Nice-to-Have Skills

Multi-threaded and high-performance software development.
Software architecture and system-level design experience.
Experience with distributed systems, data analytics, or test data processing.
Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and DevOps practices.
Familiarity with semiconductor test methodologies, memory devices (DRAM, NAND Flash, HBM), and associated test flows is highly desirable.

Benefits

Teradyne offers a variety of robust health and well-being benefits, including outpatient medical coverage, flexible benefits, life and disability insurance, paid vacation and holidays, and more.
